title: Chintamani Library v2.8.13 — Critical Universal QR, Verification & Keystore Fix
releaseNotes: CRITICAL PACKAGE SIGNATURE FIX: Embedded canonical debug keystore into build pipeline so in-app and APK updates never show package signature conflicts.
STREAMLINED HIGH-SPEED UPDATER: Fixed 'connecting to server' timeout; updates now download via direct stream with live progress and 1-tap browser fallback.
UNIVERSAL QR PORTAL FULL REPAIR: Synchronized GitHub Pages portal with authoritative backend — payment screenshots, complaints, and admissions now persist directly to the database.
SEAT MATRIX CLICK-TO-ASSIGN ENHANCEMENT: Admins can assign AVAILABLE and RESERVED seats directly to members with auto-clearing of holds and subscription expiry extensions.
